title: University of Michigan-Ann Arbor (UMich)
summary: University of Michigan-Ann Arbor (UMich) is a university in Ann Arbor. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with UMich.

sections.heading: What UMich is known for
paragraphs: The University of Michigan-Ann Arbor (UMich) is a public research university known for its large and diverse undergraduate enrollment, which totals 34,177 students. It maintains a selective admission rate of approximately 15.64%, reflecting its competitive academic environment. UMich offers a wide range of programs, with notable shares in health-related fields, comprising about 3.91% of its undergraduate population, and business programs, which account for roughly 7.46%. These strengths contribute to UMich's reputation as a comprehensive institution that provides robust educational opportunities across various disciplines.

sections.heading: How to read UMich tuition
paragraphs: The University of Michigan-Ann Arbor (UMich) tuition varies significantly depending on residency status. For in-state students, the tuition is $17,736, reflecting the reduced rate for Michigan residents. Out-of-state students face a higher tuition cost of $60,946. These figures represent the base tuition fees and do not include additional expenses. The overall cost of attendance, which encompasses tuition, fees, room, board, and other related expenses, is approximately $34,654. Understanding these distinctions is essential for prospective students when evaluating the financial commitment required to attend UMich.
